items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: the boss was named Stony, he was an Israeli man

ctx.x: Now, I lived way upstairs, there wasn't nobody in the hotel but me living. I couldn't understand that, but I was up there and I was sleeping, feeling good and the chef was kind of weird and he had them pretty women too and the boss

was named Stony, he was an Israeli man, so one night I had gone upstairs and gone to bed, and right next to the Big Apple was a synagogue and Willie the Lion, well, Willie the Lion and his brother, they were going to that synagogue, because Willie the Lion is a Catholic. His brother Melvin, the whole family, so now --
